item.description:
### Added - **Storage → Build output: see which build and dependency folders take your disk space.** Perch lists them in the projects your agents work in: `node_modules`, Swift's `.build`, Rust's `target`, Xcode's `build`, web builds, and Xcode's DerivedData. Each shows its size and when the project was last used. Perch only lists a folder git ignores and whose project file sits beside it, so release output and hand-made folders stay off the list. It warns when a folder holds an Xcode archive or an installer, which can't simply be rebuilt. Perch doesn't delete anything: Show in Finder opens the folder so you can remove it yourself.
### Fixed - **Storage sizes no longer count hard-linked files twice.** Rust `target` folders read about half again too large.
